data: Simulated Gerrit service. Production app, service, preload and renderer.
input: xdotool pointer, clicks, typing, U, Escape and Alt+F4

captions.text: Linux Electron with simulated Gerrit data. Enable separate review windows in Settings > Window.
Open a review from the board, then open the same review again.
Two instances of the same review coexist. Change the file in the right window.
Saved diff preferences apply to both windows. Set font size to 16 in the left window.
Save a comment in the left window. The right window updates without input.
Open the same saved draft in both windows. Save a new version on the left.
The right window keeps its text and pauses autosave. Keep its edit as a new draft.
Simulate a slow Gerrit save. Alt+F4 must leave the window open while the write is pending.
The save finished. The window stayed open and the saved draft reached the other view.
Type a new comment, then press Alt+F4. Escape on the discard prompt keeps the unsaved text.
Press U in the left review. App navigation keeps this review window open.
Escape dismisses Diff preferences and leaves the review window open.
Alt+F4 closes the focused review. The second review and board keep running.
